name: Zet Donaue Samson

Proficient in Linux system administration (Fedora/Ubuntu), site reliability engineering (SRE) principles, and full-stack observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki).

projects.role: Project Leader, Lead Developer & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
bullets: Enforced Zero-Trust security posture by authoring default-deny Kubernetes NetworkPolicies isolating all pod-to-pod traffic across 17+ microservice manifests
Architected reverse-proxy authentication gating using Nginx auth_request directives to verify user sessions against the backend API before granting access to protected dashboards and resources
Configured real-time observability dashboards (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki) for security monitoring, system health alerting, and incident tracking across the entire platform
Automated security operations through a 4-stage GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with change-detection matrix parallelism and ArgoCD GitOps for auditable, declarative infrastructure reconciliation

Implemented encrypted database transit, PostgreSQL-backed session persistence, and comprehensive security headers (X-Frame-Options, XSS-Protection, strict Referrer-Policy) to harden the application layer
Provisioned cloud infrastructure (DigitalOcean Kubernetes, VPC, S3 state backend) via multi-layer Terraform IaC with environment-isolated state management to prevent unauthorized configuration drift
Designed a Python ETL automation pipeline (pandas) performing time-series data aggregation, anomaly debouncing, and compliance-ready incident lifecycle logging into PostgreSQL
Refactored legacy backend web applications into high-performance C# Minimal APIs, tracing cross-stack API execution flows to maintain service availability.
Managed Git version control workflows, executing branch management, code merges, pull requests, and peer code reviews in an agile development environment.
Optimized database queries and route handlers using asynchronous programming (async/await) to reduce API latency.
Authored comprehensive unit test suites and documented modernized Minimal API endpoints to ensure long-term codebase maintainability.
Provided cross-functional technical troubleshooting, account management, and network service resolution for telecommunications subscribers.
Utilized multiple internal CRM systems and technical documentation databases simultaneously to diagnose and resolve complex customer issues under strict SLAs.

master_profile.summary_context: Computer Engineering Technology graduate with solid grounding in DevOps, GitOps, observability, zero-trust network setups, and microservices. Professional focus on building high-reliability, containerized cloud infrastructure using Terraform, Kubernetes (DOKS), Helm, and automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD). Strong C# backend experience writing Minimal APIs, optimizing queries, and handling unit test suites.

projects.title: IoT-Based Fire Monitoring & Cloud-Native Analytics Platform
projects.detailed_context: This project was a cloud-native platform integrating IoT fire sensors with real-time analytics. Infrastructure was provisioned on DigitalOcean Kubernetes Service (DOKS) using Terraform. Key technologies used: Docker, Kustomize, ArgoCD (GitOps reconciliation), GitHub Actions for matrix container builds, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki for full observability, PostgreSQL, Mosquitto MQTT broker, InfluxDB, Flyway migration hook scripts, and microservice traffic isolation via Kubernetes NetworkPolicies.

experience.detailed_context: Refactored legacy web endpoints into high-performance C# Minimal APIs (asynchronous async/await patterns), optimized Postgres query response latencies, handled git branch merges/pull requests in an agile environment, and authored robust xUnit suites.
Handled telecommunications account troubleshooting, verified client network routes, resolved technical billing queries, and operated multiple internal databases under strict SLA deadlines.
